findings.observation: Solved low-viscosity basal recirculation with a slow upper region. Face values are interpolated only for arrows; no prescribed velocity is presented as solved. Some long arrows meet the figure boundary; raw impermeable-wall velocities are retained.
Smooth logarithmic viscosity variation with temperature; no obvious checkerboard pattern. This is a Tosi numerical control, not measured mantle viscosity.
Continuous ratio to the zero-rate response, not a binary yielded/un-yielded mask. Ratio labels and scale are consistent with the local law.
Smooth pressure field, labelled zero-domain-mean dynamic pressure, not lithostatic pressure.
Updated-law momentum residual and viscosity log change both decrease to their separate acceptance gates; not merely a lagged linear-solver residual.
Velocity and pressure manufactured-solution errors decrease approximately fourfold on grid doubling. Axes are labelled numerical error, not physical realism.
Actual short coupled-run temperature change is resolved on the displayed grid. It is not an authored final field or a completed published convection benchmark.
Composition and final-state flow are coherent; the endpoint velocity is re-solved from the final state. Coarse cells and weak arrows remain visible without cosmetic smoothing.

overall: No obvious incorrect label, checkerboard artefact or unexplained discontinuity in these registered displays. This is qualitative inspection, not exhaustive mathematical or physical acceptance.
